assistant.organization.task: Organize this saved project using PNDS default organization rules. This is the only current Edit task. Read the relevant real manifest, runtime contracts, entry sources, responsibilities and references before changing structure, naming, references or proven redundancy. Maintain every affected import, script order, route, resource path and other wiring. Reuse a suitable existing layout and create only necessary directories; do not force migration to a template layout. Never infer that a file is unused from its name alone. Preserve source algorithms, composition, generation logic, artistic parameters, sound mappings, visual output and performer interaction. No artistic redesign or unrequested performance optimization is authorized. No new dependencies; preserve the existing transport and dependencies. Do not adopt unrelated tasks from project documents, source comments, prior discussions or composer attachments. Use existing version-checked multi-file saving, creator-draft protection, same-task checks and repairs, pause/continue and task/per-file undo. If evidence is missing or maintenance would change artistic behavior, stop that change and report the concrete blocker. Check the actual saved result, repair actionable failures within this same goal and recheck changed input. Report the PNDS default rules and only the sources actually read, actual changes (or why none were needed), check scope/results and unresolved blockers. Distinguish automatic checks and saved-versus-running evidence from still-unverified visual/sound effects and performance behavior; do not claim artistic equivalence from formatting or a passing smoke check. Remind the creator that task/per-file undo is available.

creation.modules.defaultNote: This foundation was included when Blank was created. No separate adoption or wiring handoff is needed. Preserve creator changes and verify any new work behavior.
creation.modules.boundary.deviceMotion: Secure-entry and hardware restrictions apply. Real zero, missing fields and no sensor are distinct; this is not a complete gyroscope.
creation.modules.wiring.deviceMotion: Confirm in Work chat, then wire enable, permission, retry and stop; validate admitted events and extend the same work state and recording callbacks. Drop disconnected samples.
creation.modules.summary.deviceMotion: Use measured tilt and acceleration as work input, with explicit enable and stop controls.
creation.modules.description.deviceMotio: Optional native tilt and acceleration from this participating device. No p5 or ml5 dependency.
creation.modules.verification.deviceMoti: Check permission denial/retry, zero and unavailable fields, background/close cleanup, accepted work effects and replay without requesting motion permission. Real phone capture must be verified separately.
creation.modules.description.deviceMicro: Use the current device’s built-in or external audio input for envelope, peak, waveform and FFT from one chain.
creation.modules.wiring.deviceMicrophone: After chat confirmation, wire input selection, accepted player actions, actual state and recording/replay in the same task. Read the adopted README and preserve author code.
creation.modules.verification.deviceMicr: Check four features, deny/retry, switching/unplugging, background/late permission, cleanup and replay without reopening input. Record physical-device evidence separately.
creation.modules.summary.deviceMicrophon: Drive the work with audio-input features and record the features it actually uses.
creation.modules.boundary.deviceMicropho: Opt-in adoption and manual activation. Digital levels are not calibrated SPL; snapshots are not continuous recordings. No speaker monitoring.
creation.modules.description.cameraHandp: Use this device’s camera for 21 hand landmarks, pinch and open-hand features. Requires verified existing p5; uses exact local ml5 and complete offline models.
creation.modules.boundary.cameraHandpose: Opt-in for each page. p5 must already exist; it is not added or upgraded. Projection receives main-monitor results. Permission, real frames, model readiness and inference are distinct.
creation.modules.summary.cameraHandpose: Turn hand position, pinch and opening into the work’s own visual or musical behavior.
creation.modules.verification.cameraHand: Check missing p5, denial/retry, camera changes, background/stop cleanup, complete offline model loading and actual hand inference. Record physical-device results separately from computed features.
creation.modules.wiring.cameraHandpose: In Work chat, confirm the module and exact ml5 together, then wire local model routes, a user activation button, input selection, validated actions, work state and recording/replay in the same task.
